description: A long, serpentine creature swims through dark blue-green water with light rays from the surface above. Its body is elongated and grey-brown with a textured, scaly look, and it curls in an S-shape. Its head is at lower right with a wide-open jaw full of sharp, pointed teeth. Small limbs or flippers appear near the tail and body, and a few small fish are faint in the background. The painting is oil-like, with visible brushstrokes, and there is no visible text, frame or border.
